austin.summary: Austin, you drafted last and somehow walked away with everybody still standing. Four for four, 4 counted points, tied for rank 1 of 5 — that's a clean opening act. Linnea, Jenna, Carter, and Eric all sit at 1 pts, all ranked 1 of 21, and your draft GPA is 3.75. Eric at pick #16 is your steal. Ep 1 gave you +4. There are 110 points still on the table, and the leader has 4. You're right there.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Nobody's pulling away yet — Linnea, Jenna, Carter, and Eric each have 1 pts and each sit at rank 1 of 21, which is about as balanced a load as a roster can carry.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Linnea is your only B grade in a roster of A's, and three of your four — Linnea, Carter, and Eric — are stacked on Savu, so your fortunes ride heavy on one tribe.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Eric, the mental health counselor who loves figuring out what makes people tick, was your pick #16 steal — watch whether that read-the-room charm keeps converting into points.
